Subject: QBR readiness: account packets, pipeline stitching & forecast lockdown

Team / Alice —

We need to lock down Q2 forecasts and assemble account-level packets for the upcoming QBR. High level asks: 

- Each account owner: one-page summary (current ARR, next milestones, top 3 risks, required actions) for the accounts you own by EOD Wed (Apr 13).
- Consolidated forecast: fill the attached workbook (tab per account). I started the Acme + NovaRetail tabs.
- Risk tags: mark accounts as GREEN/AMBER/RED and add a 1-2 line mitigation plan.

Alice — thanks for joining this thread. If you can confirm the ACV and PO cadence for Acme Retail (current committed vs expected close date), that will help us reconcile the runway.

Attachments: forecast_workbook_acme_novar_20270411.xlsx (spreadsheet with tabs)

Outcome: we want a single slide per account and a consolidated runway table for the exec pack by Thu morning so the leadership deck can be finalized.

Thanks,
Hannah

Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Hannah — thanks. I've populated the Acme and NovaRetail tabs with our current booked vs. forecast numbers and added a short notes column for assumptions (discounting, deployment timeline). See attached workbook (forecast_workbook_acme_novar_20270411.xlsx).

Quick notes:
- Acme: committed pilot order is $120k ARR starting May; procurement indicated a formal PO in May but they want SOW clarifications (see comments). Forecast line shows $360k by EOY if rollout goes per plan, but we should model a conservative $240k scenario for runway.
- NovaRetail: likelihood shifted to 60% after last week's POC; legal loop could add 2–3 weeks.

I'll also drop a cleaned CSV into the HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.com/deal/74219) for the forecast import.

Attachment: forecast_workbook_acme_novar_20270411.xlsx

-Vivek

Hannah / Vivek —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick updates from Acme side: 

- Committed pilot PO for $120k (signed internal memo) — procurement is preparing the formal PO and expects to release it by 05/05.
- We are targeting a phased rollout: pilot -> regional expansion -> national in Q4. Conservative forecast for Q2 show $150k recognized; optimistic $300k if procurement moves faster.
- Legal raised a question on data retention and where inference logs are stored; I copied procurement/legal on this thread (procurement@acme-retail.com).

I attached a sample terms doc the procurement team requested. We'll aim to get the PO on file by May 5.

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of ML Integrations | Acme Retail
alice@acme-retail.com

Uploading the one-pagers and consolidated risk matrix. See attachments: QBR_account_packets_v2.pdf (one slide per account) and updated forecast workbook. Key highlights: 

- Acme Retail: RISK = AMBER. Mitigation: legal + procurement sync; locked pilot numbers but conservative recognition schedule. Action owner: Vivek (procurement liaison) / Hannah (executive readout).
- NovaRetail: RISK = GREEN->AMBER pending legal; implementation ok but timeline slipping two weeks.
- Added an "Assumptions" column across all accounts (discounts, expected time-to-value).

Also noted a small discrepancy between HubSpot ARR and the workbook for Acme — Vivek, can you confirm the source-of-truth (CRM export vs finance)? I've linked the HubSpot deal in the pack.

- Vivek: please reconcile HubSpot vs workbook by Thu 11:00 so finance has a single CSV to ingest.
- Alice / Acme: Hannah + Vivek will schedule a 30m legal/procurement sync (mortgage of outstanding SOW items). Proposed slots: Thu 4/15 09:30-10:00 PT or Fri 4/16 08:00-08:30 PT. Which works?

Attachments: SOW_redline_v1.docx (high-level redlines we intend to address in sync)

Appreciate the quick responses — looks like we're in good shape to finalize the deck by Friday.

Best,
